content: Table TABREF8 shows the results for the baseline models as well as the HUMAN measured performance on the task. The human performance provides an upper bound for the RUN task performance, while the simple baselines provide lower bounds. The best baseline model is NO-MOVE, reaching an accuracy of 30.3% on single sentences and 0.3 on complete paragraphs. For the HUMAN case, paragraph accuracy reaches above 80.
